description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our ADAS Team

Wayve's ADAS engineering teams build the perception and intelligence that power driver assistance in real-world driving. We work end-to-end, from creating high-quality training data, to developing and evaluating CV/3D perception models, to iterating quickly based on performance gaps. The team mixes "online" (on-car, latency/compute constrained) and "offline" (heavier, large-scale data generation) work, with a strong focus on measurable impact and shipping.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Train, debug, and improve computer vision and 3D perception models, iterating based on clear evaluation signals

- Work across the full ML lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, and iteration

- Partner with the team to decide what to tackle next, based on where the system is underperforming

- Build scalable data pipelines, including auto-labelling and pseudo-labelling, to accelerate model development

 

🧩 What you'll be working on:

- Core ADAS perception capabilities such as detection, classification, and instance segmentation, spanning lanes, objects, traffic signs, and traffic lights

- End-to-end approaches that let the model act on the world directly, rather than relying on a chain of hand-coded intermediate steps (lane assist without ever explicitly detecting lane lines is the kind of outcome we're after)

- Online perception that runs fast in-car as part of our production stack

- Offline perception work using additional inputs not viable for on-road production, including extra sensors like lidar, future frames, maps, and extra compute, to improve data quality and coverage at scale

- Building the "data flywheel": using offline models and 3D tracking/reconstruction to auto-generate labels and accelerate iteration across perception tasks

 

👤 You should apply if:

- Built and shipped CV-focused deep learning systems, with strong applied ML engineering rather than research-only work

- Experience with 3D perception concepts or pipelines, such as LiDAR, multi-view geometry, tracking, or 3D reconstruction

- Comfortable owning work end-to-end, including evaluation and large-scale dataset generation

- Enjoy pragmatic problem-solving under real product constraints

- Excited to improve real-world driving performance through better perception

- Automotive domain experience is a bonus, but not a blocker if your perception background comes from elsewhere

🌱 Not ticking every box? That's totally okay! If you're passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚗 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve's mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. description:
Description
MetalBear is remote-first, early-stage, and product-led. We're building mirrord, a Kubernetes development platform that lets developers and AI coding agents run code against a live cluster before it's deployed.
The problem we solve is the wait. In any organization running microservices, checking whether a change actually works means building an image, pushing it, deploying to a shared environment, and waiting on a pipeline to tell you. That loop runs many times a day per engineer, and it's the single biggest tax on how fast an organization ships. With mirrord, the service runs wherever the work is already happening: on a laptop, in CI, or inside an agent's sandbox. Its traffic, environment variables, and file access are forwarded to and from a shared staging cluster, so the service behaves exactly as it would if it were deployed, without deploying it. Feedback arrives in seconds instead of minutes, against real APIs, real schemas, and real traffic rather than mocks or a hand-maintained local stack.
That matters more every month, because AI agents now write a large share of the code our customers ship. An agent generating code from static files is guessing at how the rest of the system behaves, and a human has to catch the guesses. mirrord gives the agent the real context to write against and a real feedback loop to verify against, so what lands in review is something a reviewer can trust.
mirrord is used by thousands of developers worldwide , including at Fortune 500 companies .
The Cloud Integrations team owns features that involve automatically managing users’ cloud services (like message brokers, databases, Kubernetes resources and more) to create virtually separate environments with only minimal resource duplication. title: Builder
description:
WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel.

Tacto is building the intelligence layer between bits and atoms, connecting the digital world of engineering with the physical world of manufacturing. It’s how AI gets into the real economy. More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto. We’re the category leader in DACH, backed by Sequoia and Index, and we’re just getting started.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Find the problems worth solving, then solve them end to end. Sit with buyers and procurement leads, work out what actually costs them money, decide what's worth building, and ship it to production, with AI doing much of the heavy lifting. You're done when it drives revenue, not when it's released. Don't wait for a PRD: make the case, or skip the case and show the prototype.

 

WHAT WE MEAN BY BUILDER

Because of AI, we only hire Builders. No specialized roles. At Tacto, some of our Builders come from product, some from engineering, some from founding their own company. They all have one thing in common: they take a messy, unclear problem and own it from start to finish, whether it's a customer problem or a business problem. They decide what is worth doing, test the risky parts early, and see it through until it pays off. When it works, they share it, we double down, and everyone gets better.

We care about outcomes, not code quality for its own sake. What makes this fun is the loop from idea to reality, and AI just made that loop 10x shorter. There’s no room here for “my job is to solve interesting technical problems.”

 

WHAT A WEEK CAN LOOK LIKE

- A call or a plant visit with a procurement team to see how they really buy

- A prototype built with Claude Code or Cursor the next morning

- Shipping with a team of 1-3 Builders on one of the quarter's bets

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Hungry, creative people who care about the result more than anything else.

- You've built something people used and owned the outcome: as a founder, in a fast-growing product team, or with a side project that you launched.

- You have commercial sense and product taste. Agency and taste are the main differentiators in today's AGI age.

- You build with AI every day. Cursor, Claude, Codex and agents are your default and you've made something real with them that wouldn't exist otherwise.

- You have strong technical intuition: you reason about data and systems rather than getting caught up in the details of code.

- You're comfortable in front of industrial customers. You are fluent in German; English is strong plus.

- You want to be in a room full of people who are fired up about what they’re building.

- Early in your career? Great. We love to bet on people with a steep learning curve.

 

HOW THE PROCESS WORKS

1. Say Hello (20 min): get to know each other and the role

2. Hiring Manager Interview (45 min)

3. On-site day: a case with three Builders and Pool Leads (1 hour), Meet the Team (30 min)

HOW WE WORK

We’re in our Munich office four days a week, with 100+ people building together every day. We measure outcomes. Trust is high and feedback is direct. We offer competitive salary and meaningful equity.

OUR BACKGROUND

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

description:
Why Work at Mercer Advisors?

For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. We deliver the kind of comprehensive care once reserved for only the wealthiest households.

Today, we serve over 42,800+ families across 110+ cities across the U.S. Ranked the #1 RIA Firm in the nation by Barron’s for two consecutive years, Mercer Advisors is an independent fiduciary legally bound to act in our clients’ best interests - always.*

Mercer Advisors offers a workplace that stands apart in the financial industry. More than half of our employees and client-facing professionals are women, reflecting the clients we serve. With a flexible, national footprint, we build our teams around exceptional talent - wherever they are.

Join us and help families amplify and simplify their financial lives with confidence.

* Mercer Advisors was ranked #1 for RIA firms with up to $70 billion in assets. The Barron’s top RIA ranking is based on a combination of metrics - including size, growth, service quality, technology, succession planning and others. No fee was paid for participation in the ranking, however, Mercer Advisors has paid a fee to Barron’s to use the ranking in marketing. Please see important information about the ranking criteria methodology  here .

About Fifteenth

Fifteenth by Mercer Advisors is a tax planning group built for new wealth. Our clients are tech employees, founders, VCs and investors. 

The role

We're hiring a Senior Tax Manager to lead client relationships and own the tax work for a book of tech clients. You'll review and sign returns, build projections, and give planning advice that helps clients make better decisions about their equity and income.

 

Our tax group is also rethinking how tax work gets done. We use AI and technology to work smarter and faster. We test new processes constantly and work directly with our engineers and product team to shape the tools we use. This role is a big part of that.

 

What you'll do

• Lead client relationships and be the main tax contact for your clients.

• Review and sign individual income tax returns, including complex multi-state and equity-heavy returns.

• Build and review tax projections, quarterly estimates and planning analyses.

• Advise clients on equity compensation: ISOs, NSOs, RSUs, ESPPs, 83(b) elections and exercise strategy.

• Help founders and investors with liquidity events, QSBS, fund K-1s and carried interest.

• Answer client tax questions clearly and quickly.

• Resolve tax notices and agency correspondence.

• Track tax law changes and explain what they mean for clients.

• Test new AI-driven workflows and give the engineering and product teams direct feedback.

 

What you bring

• 8+ years of individual tax experience in public accounting or a similar setting

• CPA or EA, with authority to sign returns

• Deep knowledge of individual income tax, especially equity compensation and multi-state issues

• Experience leading client relationships and explaining complex topics simply

• Comfort owning your work end to end

• Curiosity about AI and new tools

• A real passion for client service

• Experience with CCH Axcess and Bloomberg Tax (BNA) Income Tax Planner is a plus

Schedule and location

Core hours are Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM local time. Some longer days come with tax deadlines. This role is remote within the U.S.

Application Deadline : The initial deadline for applications is 11/29/2026. Applications submitted after this date may still be considered on a rolling basis until the position/program is filled. We encourage all interested candidates to apply as early as possible. If a final decision has not been made by the initial deadline, subsequent applications will be reviewed as they are received.
